summary: {manager} decides how to enforce the hearing-aid age restriction in a store with open shelves.
realLife: Some commenters wanted locked cabinets or counter service. FDA left retailers flexibility over shelf placement while retaining the restriction on sales to or for minors.
inGame: needs: retailer placement and age-of-sale procedures.

turns.pulledBy: The retailer chooses a staffed counter.
turns.what: The manager assigns the case key to a clerk.
turns.writesBack: A customer has to find a clerk before comparing boxes.

turns.what: The manager briefs staff on open-shelf sales.
turns.writesBack: The manager explains how staff will handle age restrictions at sale.
